scope: Five fresh serial isolated gpt-5.6-terra native/OpenSky Mac task pairs; actual outcome and exact owned cleanup reviewed. Descriptive comparison, not causal whole-agent improvement.
metricDefinition: Native100; per-pair index100*min(OpenSky/native elapsed time, estimated cost, aggregate input tokens). Only latest complete reviewed pairs included.

limits: Both enter requested operands/operators and compute99; native extra trailing plus remains, canonical expression equality unproven. One-read patch verified by actual trace/control; whole-time variation dominates and descriptive index gain is not causal source proof.
Actual requested tabs and running/paused/reset stopwatch states verified. Indexed-click negative control unaffected by keyboard patch; native batching differs, no source gain inferred.
Actual newly created saved RTF text/style and end caret verified; cold restoration initially exposed previous retained native document. Single pair descriptive, no causal whole-time gain inferred.
Independent retained Drafts/Ready verified; native lost-character/paste recovery and incidental clipping counted; SDK inline-name recovery counted. Single pair descriptive.
Requested URL history/tab lifecycle verified. Reload exact button and changed tree observed, no instrumented origin request count. Single pair descriptive.

cleanup: All owned apps/windows/helpers and live saved files/folder fixtures cleared; unrelated original Calendar process and window preserved.
limits: Retired/incomplete arms excluded; their original transcripts and failures retained.
Aggregate input is a context proxy; costs are estimated, not subscription billing.
Descriptive control ratios are not causal evidence of a repair. Canonical platform matrix pending.
Calculator native final history contains an extra trailing plus; requested operands/operators and result99 are verified, canonical expression identity is not.
TextEdit cold restoration initially exposed prior retained document before a distinct new blank document was created and saved.
Finder native recovered dropped character, ineffective setValue and misplaced paste; incidental clipping retained. SDK recovered inline rename transitions.
Safari reload dispatch and changed page tree verified; origin request count not instrumented.
Whole-agent timing variability prevents causal attribution of batch score gains to the keyboard patch.
